brief:
Eighteen Arab members of the Knesset left the parliament chamber when Israel's national anthem, "Hatikva," began playing, Shehab Wire reported. The walkout occurred during a session in which the anthem was performed.

The song, whose title translates to "The Hope," serves as Israel's national anthem. The departure by the Arab parliamentarians marked a protest against its playing in the Knesset.
